semantics: User updates are optional observations over an ordinary FLOW channel. Messages are closed JSON/0 objects. All strings contain Unicode scalar values. A canonical encoded item is at most 32768 UTF-8 bytes. notice text has 1–4096 scalars and is one complete attributed message, with newlines allowed; it appends to the transcript and is not a fragment. activity id has 1–64 scalars and label has 1–256; a progress unit has 1–32. Labels and units contain no CR, LF, U+2028 or U+2029. IDs are opaque presentation slots, not durable tasks, native paths or host-attested provenance. An activity fully replaces label and optional progress for (connected source instance,id); omission removes previous progress. Replacement retains first-appearance order. clear removes that slot idempotently; unknown IDs do nothing and later reuse creates a new appearance. Retirement removes only that source's slots, without restoring old snapshots or undoing work. Validated complete notices already accepted by a bounded presenter retain its ownership and order through ordinary source retirement, subject to output failure, quota and cancellation. Printed notices cannot be retracted. Only consecutive unsent tail activities for the same ID may coalesce; notices and clears are ordering barriers. Transport sequence establishes accepted order, not an application revision counter. completed and total are safe nonnegative integers through 9007199254740991; completed must not exceed total when present. Zero total requires zero completed and means a count without a percentage; omitted total also means a count only. Later snapshots may decrease counts, change totals or units, or omit progress. Never round an incomplete count to 100%. Counts, exact 100%, clear and EOF are observations, never execution success. No monotonicity, rate, ETA, hierarchy, replay, acknowledgement or completeness guarantee is provided. EOF ends the selected sequence; it does not establish complete upstream history or domain success. Every source ending retires its activities. Host cancellation/stopping/cleanup/terminal state takes precedence over application observation; late callbacks cannot restore retired state. Shared budgets may stop healthy contributors; isolated retirement is not commutativity, fairness, independent transcript or outcome invariance. Absent or lost observation does not restart, retry or rebind domain work. Parents deliberately validate and relay separate child channels, own receiver disposal, map each bounded child occurrence to fresh collision-free outgoing IDs, fence producers before ordered clears, and settle pending relay work before ID reuse. ACP fragments and plans retain their separate contract and cannot be silently reinterpreted as these complete notices or counts. Output delivery may fail independently of application results; important outcome evidence also belongs in application results or artifacts.
